recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍紅血球大很多的橢圓形組織球，單一小而深染的細胞核，細胞質豐富、藍色，充滿纖細波浪狀條紋，像揉皺的面紙或洋蔥皮；這種條紋狀細胞質是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的標誌。
features: Very large oval histiocyte, several times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Single small, dense nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin, slightly off-center; low N:C ratio
Abundant blue cytoplasm with prominent fine wavy fibrillary striations (crumpled tissue paper appearance)
No foamy vacuoles, discrete blue granules, or phagocytosed cells
Background of overlapping red cells in a thick area of the smear
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large oval histiocyte surrounded by overlapping red cells. The cell has a single small, dense nucleus with clumped chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm containing fine, wavy fibrillary striations resembling crumpled tissue paper. Foamy vacuolation, ceroid granules, and hemophagocytosis are absent. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; enzyme assay for glucocerebrosidase or GBA1 genotyping is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical, so separation depends on the underlying disorder, AFB stain, and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly foamy, soap-bubble cytoplasm instead of fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than a wrinkled striated texture.
